title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Combined Deduction Ceiling with a Payroll-Repaid Loan
content:
Holding a Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan changes how much early pay a worker can take on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan.

**Rule.** When the worker has a loan in repayment with an installment scheduled on the plan's next payday (the installments of the worker's repaying Paystride payroll-repaid loans whose next installment date is that payday, above zero), the period's transfers plus that installment may not exceed the tier's combined deduction ceiling percentage of the period's accrued net earnings; the room this leaves is limit (e) of the transfer availability rules. A worker with no such installment is not subject to this limit, and the limit never changes the loan installment itself.

**The room.** The ceiling percentage of the period's accrued net earnings, less the period's transfer total, less the installment due on the next payday.

*Hypothetical:* accrued net of 900.00 USD, 50 percent ceiling, transfers so far 210.00 USD and an installment of 125.00 USD due the same payday: the room is 450.00 USD less 210.00 USD less 125.00 USD, 115.00 USD. With the installment due on a later date instead, the limit does not apply.
